g.text: The 62D low-block inverse is exactly inert on the certified tail; the degree-81 column scan is finite regression only.

text.style: font-size: 5.22px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'Times', serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #6b675f

g.text: This is a local analytic branch certificate, not a proof of three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity.
